translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: Charging under this bombardment... is reckless!」

逆だろう」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「The enemy is launching a powerful attack.

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: We must charge immediately to stop it.」

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「足の止まった兵は裏切り者だ！
裏切り者は処刑しろ！」
「はははは、代わりの兵ならいくらでもいるぞ！」
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「Hahaha, there are plenty of replacement soldiers!」

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 遠距離攻撃用の魔物兵は

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: were speechless at the General's words.

お前も儂を裏切るつもりか？」
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: Are you planning to betray me too?」

「あぎゃああああ！」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: If you're lucky you might not die!」

リーザス軍――

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「Magnificent! That's the only word for it!」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「It looks foolish at first glance, but

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: those reckless charges are still... painful...」

数に任せた戦いをされるのが

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: is the hardest for us to deal with.」

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「その上、教育も行き届いとる。

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: Even under that rain of cannon fire,

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: they charge straight ahead without fleeing...

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「足下がふらついたならば、

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: we could have bought more time under the bombardment.」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: Sensing this was the right moment, Bares turned to his subordinates.

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: make sure not to pursue too deeply.」

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「はっ、了解いたしました！」
「それと、砲兵部隊は今夜中に陣地を撤収させよ。
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「Also, have the artillery unit withdraw their position by tonight.

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: But abandoning cannons of that power is a bit...」
